title: Scott Steiner betrays his brother
summary: Scott Steiner chooses the nWo over his long partnership with Rick. Rick pursues revenge while Scott and Buff Bagwell use repeated deception to delay a fair confrontation.

chapters.title: Scott turns during the tag-title match
chapters.result: Scott attacks Rick and helps the Outsiders win the tag titles.
chapters.context: The betrayal ends the brothers’ established partnership and aligns Scott with the nWo.

chapters.title: Rick beats Scott after another Bagwell betrayal
chapters.result: Rick wins the tag titles, then defeats Scott in singles action.
chapters.context: Bagwell abandons Rick in the tag match, but Rick still earns and wins his immediate match against his brother.
